Richard Moody's Holiday Gift Giving Party Returns to the Granada Theater in Uptown Minneapolis

The long-running December tradition collects gifts and donations for Twin Cities kids, teens and families on Monday, December 14, from 7 to 11 p.m.

MINNEAPOLIS, MN, — Richard Moody, founder of the Minneapolis event production company IAmMoody, hosts his annual Holiday Gift Giving Party on Monday, December 14, 2026, from 7 to 11 p.m. at the Granada Theater, 3022 Hennepin Ave. in Uptown Minneapolis. The evening brings together friends, neighbors, models, business partners and supporters to celebrate the season and give back.

Guests are asked to bring a new, unwrapped gift. Teens are often overlooked in holiday giving, so gifts for teenagers are especially welcome. Cash donations are also accepted.

For more than three decades, Moody's December party has turned a night out into a drive for children, teens and families in the Twin Cities. Past beneficiaries include Sabathani Community Center, The Sanneh Foundation, WE WIN Institute, the Domestic Abuse Project and The Link. In 2020, when gathering in person wasn't possible, the party became a drive-thru toy and food donation event so the giving could continue.

Street parking and the Calhoun Square (7 Corners) ramp are suggested.

About IAmMoody

IAmMoody is a Minneapolis fashion show and event production company founded by Richard Moody. Richard started on the runway as a model and went on to produce, choreograph and host events in Minneapolis, Paris and London. IAmMoody produces runway shows, custom events and brand activations, along with its own signature series: the annual Holiday Charity Party, which collects gifts and donations for Twin Cities kids, teens and families, and the All Black Attire Party men's fashion show.
